milestones.title: Prove the foundations
milestones.outcome: Roster and selected stills locked; all 40 integrated in source. By Oct 25: native Fernlands proof, measured production forecast and initial operations/device decisions.
milestones.gate: Oct 25: if slice or measured capacity misses, stop optional work and present resources/date tradeoffs. Keep the locked 40 unless Frozair changes scope.

milestones.title: Connect all five
milestones.outcome: All five source loops and exact-eight data are connected early. Complete fresh-player native acceptance, final normal-access pacing and hosted rollout evidence by Nov 1.
milestones.gate: All five are playable; first integration is not final art acceptance.

milestones.title: Finish the world
milestones.outcome: All 40 residents: required movement/actions/reveals, five habitats and expansion stages accepted. Freeze new features and content.
milestones.gate: Nov 8: both platforms pass the five-island walkthrough. Cut optional features first; any roster/date change needs Frozair.

milestones.title: Play it for a week
milestones.outcome: Seven days of signed beta observations, device checks and recovery evidence.
milestones.gate: Fresh/returning players, both OSes, offline/retry/recovery and supported-device endurance pass.

milestones.title: Submit, then stabilise
milestones.outcome: Public submissions Nov 16. Resolve store feedback and release defects.
milestones.gate: Public Apple + Google review, not just TestFlight/Play Internal. Approval timing is external.

milestones.title: Open the sanctuary
milestones.outcome: Five accepted islands. Approved public builds. Recovery and monitoring ready.
milestones.gate: Launch only when gates are green. Never trade save safety or a complete island for the date.

work.title: Put Fernlands on a phone
work.why: All five launch destinations and all 40 residents are integrated in source. Recorded local database and desktop loops pass; no launch-data hosted rollout or native all-five acceptance is claimed.
work.doneWhen: Next separately authorized build: Fernlands survives a fresh-player full loop and OS kill/relaunch on Android and iOS by Oct 25; all five qualify by Nov 1. Arrange iOS hardware. No legacy-owner relocation work is required under the fresh-start decision.

work.title: Benchmark the 19 missing packages
work.why: 21 committed ranch banks exist and 19 are missing. All 40 selected still references are approved, including Brachio R8; changed looks still need motion identity checks. No further video spending is authorized.
work.doneWhen: Prepare a costed method and obtain the next production authorization; time one full Iguanodon package and bounded Titanoboa/Mammoth proofs. Recalculate remaining full packages / days to Nov 8, including rework and worlds. Today’s 19 over 20 days is about 6.7/week, a requirement rather than measured output.

work.title: Accept the provisional 40-species data
work.why: Migrations d6618bbce and 59b51e2a4 seed all 40 in approved homes; exact eight-species shops/Books and five one-time collection goals are locally verified. New profiles borrow existing values under authorization.
work.doneWhen: Review final tiers, pacing, voices and habitat behavior; qualify fresh-player native flow and separately approved hosted rollout. Fresh-start approval supersedes legacy-save migration work. Retain normal gameplay persistence and collection guarantees after the start.

work.title: See what alpha players do
work.why: Build 706 Android ingestion and four alpha dashboard insights are verified (#45 Done). Broader coverage is tracked in #60.
work.doneWhen: Review QA-excluded cohorts as time elapses; add observed progression, pacing and pity coverage. Empty charts do not establish retention.

work.title: Qualify current banks and finish motion faults
work.why: Para/Kentro and Rex’s accepted reveal are committed. #52 source sequencing fixes exist; old Rex actions, bridge art and native acceptance remain. Match banks to the approved Oct 19 still baseline before reuse.
work.doneWhen: Accept affected source motion and renderer joins; record exact native build evidence when build work is authorized. Do not reopen completed Para work or call build 706 proof of newer fixes.

work.title: Prove recovery before adding more content
work.why: Historical hosted backup/restore, crash receipt and staging capacity evidence is incomplete. Discover limits this week.
work.doneWhen: Confirm backup configuration, crash alert receipt and minimum-device baseline Oct 25; isolated hosted restore and load rehearsal by Nov 1.

work.title: Connect Treasure to the next island
work.why: A five-island ladder using existing values is integrated provisionally. Correct unlocks under fixture cash/time do not validate ordinary attendance, affordability or final found-Treasure progression.
work.doneWhen: Review final bills/offline policy and Treasure direction by Oct 25; model ordinary attendance and unlucky tails, then native observations by Nov 1. Provisional Fernlands prices remain much cheaper than its late gate; this is not final pacing approval.

work.title: Finish the five island casts + worlds
work.why: All 40 selected stills and source roster rows are accepted/connected. Nineteen residents still lack ranch banks; the existing 21 need identity, motion, reveal and native checks. Five final worlds and expansion stages remain.
work.doneWhen: All 40 pass movement/actions, hatch/reveal, variants, eggs, Book, voice coverage and their island expansion stages. Measure complete accepted output, including rework; escalate any capacity/date conflict without automatic roster cuts.

work.title: Prove phone performance + recovery
work.why: Older debug captures cannot certify the final release build.
work.doneWhen: First backup/monitoring and device baseline by Oct 25; isolated hosted restore and staging load by Nov 1; final candidate recovery/endurance regression by Nov 15.

work.title: Start the public-store checklist
work.why: Age/privacy decisions, listing assets and public review can block an otherwise finished game.
work.doneWhen: Resolve project’s audience/sign-in requirement, align disclosures, finish assets and submit both public builds Nov 16.

work.title: Sky after the first five
work.why: Frozair prefers Sky to Water. Flying routes add a separate production/motion problem.
work.doneWhen: Choose next-island scope after the five-island release is stable.

decisions.title: The 40 and their homes are locked
decisions.recommendation: Frozair approved the complete five-island roster. Iguanodon and Brachio are in Fernlands; the revised Snow eight are fixed. Casting is complete; final art and native acceptance remain.

decisions.title: What does each island require?
decisions.recommendation: Existing-value unlocks and borrowed economic profiles are authorized provisionally and locally implemented. Final pacing, tiers, found-Treasure gates/resource bills and offline policy still need review; rare mutations remain optional.

decisions.title: Paid launch or free launch?
decisions.recommendation: Choose one small, proven purchase loop only if it fits. Otherwise launch free and schedule monetisation next. Full pass/catalog is a proposed deferral.

decisions.title: Which phones do we promise?
decisions.recommendation: Agree minimum Android/iPhone devices and budgets. Android is available; #56 reports no iOS device. Arrange iOS coverage for the Oct 25 proof; a separate Mystery Egg Bag Moto debug pass does not qualify the launch five.

decisions.title: Does the measured pace fit Nov 8?
decisions.recommendation: Compare accepted full packages and world/data work with remaining capacity. If the forecast misses, remove optional features first, then ask Frozair to choose resources/date tradeoffs. Do not silently cut residents.

decisions.title: Approve the next creature production step
decisions.recommendation: All 40 selected stills are approved; no further video spending is authorized. Review a costed method and spending limit for one full Iguanodon package plus bounded body proofs before new production. Preserve current Rex and Leafy.

risks.title: 19 new banks plus qualification
risks.action: Oct 19 audit still finds 21 committed ranch banks and 19 missing; no additional production rate is established. With 20 days to Nov 8 the new-bank floor is about 6.7/week before rework, look matching, reveals, worlds/data and QA. Confirm the next production method/spending, then measure actual accepted output by Oct 25.

risks.title: Unproven body types and wetland behavior
risks.action: Prove Mammoth weight, Titanoboa continuous motion and aquatic residents’ water access early. Validate 16 residents, duplicate mixes and service clearance; still concepts are insufficient.

risks.title: Native five-island proof is still missing
risks.action: Source integration and recorded desktop loops are complete. Next approved build needs Fernlands fresh-player native proof by Oct 25 and all-five proof by Nov 1, including iOS coverage. Hosted launch rollout is separate.

risks.title: Progression still unproved
risks.action: Provisional existing values keep source work moving; large gate/price mismatches are not approved final pacing. Model ordinary attendance and unlucky tails, then confirm with players.

risks.title: Public review is external
risks.action: Start setup now; submit Nov 16 and protect the final fortnight for fixes.

risks.title: Recovery is not yet proven
risks.action: Recheck dated backup/monitoring gaps now. Initial proof Oct 25, hosted isolated restore and staging load Nov 1; final regression Nov 15.

launchGates.label: Understandable progression
launchGates.proof: Fresh-player and ordinary-return observations; credible normal-dino gate route, no ultra-rare requirement. Exact values approved.

launchGates.label: Stable release phones

launchGates.label: Saves + operations
launchGates.proof: Update/reinstall/account-link recovery, hosted backup and isolated restore, crash receipt, load/rollback evidence. No known critical data or duplication faults.

launchGates.label: Both stores approved
launchGates.proof: Public approvals for the exact candidates; listings, disclosures, audience/deletion path and any paid receipt/odds flows complete.

launchGates.label: Director acceptance

changes.text: All 40 now seeded in approved source homes, eight per shop/Book, with five active islands and recorded local loop proof. Native/hosted launch rollout and final balance remain open; 19 still use placeholder art. Selected still baseline approved, Rex reveal committed. Fresh-start decision retires legacy relocation work.

Frozair locked all 40 species and island homes. Casting review closed. Fresh source audit: 21 committed ranch banks, 19 missing; 14/40 obtainable anywhere, 10/40 in intended homes. Para/Kentro are committed; Dilophosaurus has banks. Fernlands phone slice and production benchmark lead the updated plan.

Recommended habitat revision: Iguanodon → greener Fernlands; Nanuqsaurus, Prince Creek Edmontosaurus, Leaellynasaura and Woolly Rhinoceros proposed for Snow. Borealopelta, Cryolophosaurus, Citipati and Concavenator benched in this proposal. Eight per island/40 total and all milestone dates stay; no game data changes.
Frozair superseded 28 with 40 launch species: eight per island. Brachio → Fernlands; Paraceratherium out. Supporting moves remain proposals. Dates stay; capacity must be proved.
Analytics #45 Done: build 706 Android ingestion and four alpha dashboard insights verified. Coverage follow-up is #60; retention needs elapsed, non-QA cohorts.
Superseded: Frozair initially approved 28 species and reviewed 28 picks + 12 alternates. The later eight-per-island decision sets launch scope to 40.

evidence.label: Baseline
evidence.detail: Production handoff, Oct 18: alpha 0.1.6 build 706 distributed to TestFlight internal and Play Internal. Reused reported evidence; this roadmap did not reinstall or certify a build.

evidence.label: Concepts vs runtime
evidence.detail: Latest board #23–30, #42, #49–51; accepted concepts do not establish completed runtime art, roster data or launch readiness.

evidence.label: Release limits
evidence.detail: docs/release-security.md; docs/posthog-rollout.md; fastlane/Fastfile. Historical check counts and internal distribution do not establish public-store approval or current operational readiness.

evidence.label: Analytics rollout
evidence.detail: Latest #45 is Done: native Android build 706 → server → PostHog ingestion, retry dedup and four saved alpha insights verified. QA is excluded; empty non-QA charts are not retention results. #60 owns missing coverage.

evidence.label: Approved roster and habitat
evidence.detail: Explicit Frozair approval Oct 18 locks the revised 40 and all homes. Snow: seasonal woodland/stream edges/open forage; five stronger cold/polar fits and three conditional (Yuty/Sino/Lea). Original sources and uncertainty remain on the roster page.

evidence.label: Source integration · reviewed Oct 19
evidence.detail: Current HEAD 4a565500e. d6618bbce + 59b51e2a4 seed the exact 40/eight per source home/shop/Book; active Forest → Giants → Snowy → Swampy → Fernlands, Water inactive. Nineteen missing banks resolve to the existing generic Leafy fallback. No launch migration rollout is claimed.

evidence.label: Recorded local proof and limits
evidence.detail: #56 evidence includes disposable-database 634 checks and graphical five-island tour 129, plus cache/storage/events/Book coverage. Reports are tied to their recorded source snapshots; later Mystery Egg Bag/Backend edits mean they are not a fresh full current-HEAD pass. This maintenance review did not rerun game tests, build or certify phones.

evidence.label: Latest device/backend scope
evidence.detail: #48 reports an authorized Moto debug pass at 27a11e4f1 and hosted Egg Bag migration 20261019100000 only. The pending launch migrations were explicitly excluded. Pixel install deferred; no iOS launch device evidence. This does not establish a new distributed alpha or public approval.

evidence.label: Selected stills and animation banks
evidence.detail: Oct 19 approved still reference snapshot r8-brachio-smile matches the locked 40; Brachio R8 selected, current Rex/Leafy retained. Leafy is stylized Velociraptor. Still approval is not motion acceptance. Banks remain 21/19; 20 dedicated reveals, Stegouros fallback. Rex reveal 9b8cd0a95 is committed; Gallimimus edits remain local.

evidence.label: Capacity calculation · Oct 19
evidence.detail: 19 missing ranch banks / 20 days to Nov 8 × 7 = 6.65, displayed as about 6.7/week. Full-package rework, existing-bank selected-look/reveal checks, worlds and device qualification are additional. No new production spending or rate is established.

evidence.label: Fresh-start policy
evidence.detail: Latest Director decision in CLAUDE.md/#56: treat launch as a new game; pre-release tester data will be reset. No legacy-home grandfathering, relocation or compensation work is required. This review executes no reset; normal fresh-player persistence and collection guarantees remain required.

firstWork.title: Next: the first phone proof.
firstWork.note: Source integration is ahead of the milestone. Keep native proof, production capacity and operations separate; final balance and all 40 creature/world acceptances remain open.

items.title: Prove Fernlands on phones
items.outcome: Recorded source/desktop loops pass. Next approved build: fresh arrival → hatch → work → sell → expand → kill/relaunch. Fernlands by Oct 25; all five by Nov 1, on Android and iOS. Arrange iOS coverage.

items.title: Protect progression and saves
items.outcome: Review provisional five-island pacing and device limits; confirm backup/crash receipt and public-store setup. Capacity check stays Oct 25. Fresh-start launch is approved; no legacy relocation work is required.
